question_record.context: During a suspicious access to the LSASS service on 2024-07-04, it was suspected that attackers decrypted user passwords from the LSASS service's memory. These credentials might have been used to infiltrate other machines and servers in the network using lateral movement activities. One of the alerts connected to this incident indicated the execution of a known malicious credential theft tool.
question_record.question: Can you provide the command line execution details of the known credential theft tool that was detected?
solution: There was a suspicious access to the LSASS service on host `vnevado-win10v` detected on 2024-07-04 22:35:03.532131+00:00.

A malicious credential theft tool, specifically `mimikatz.exe`, was executed on 2024-06-27 at 14:33:38.0249949 UTC with the command line `mimikatz.exe lsadump::dcsync /domain:vnevado.alpineskihouse.co /user:xfbzkp` and Process ID `4748`.

102.name: Suspicious access to LSASS service
102.description: In order to obtain clear-text password, attackers must decrypt the user's password from the LSASS service's memory. Multiple public tools as well as custom ones could be used to perform this operation. Once obtained, these credentials are often used in lateral movement activities to infiltrate other machines and servers in the network.

26.name: Malicious credential theft tool execution detected
26.description:
A known credential theft tool execution command line was detected.
Either the process itself or its command line indicated an intent to dump users' credentials, keys, plain-text passwords and more.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention' AND o.Concept = 'Host_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s,%s,%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Host_Name' AND o.Concept = 'Process_Identity'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
